title: danthonia patula var. glabrata
intro: Danthonia patula var. glabrata, commonly known as  Poverty Grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Danthonia patula var. glabrata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help reduce symptoms of arthritis and wound healing.
